messages:
carla: quick flag — console shows lower v2 traffic for tenant Z than routing logs (12% vs 24%). anyone seen this?
matt: is this just for streaming routes?
carla: yes, streaming + token-level quota routes. console aggregates fragments differently.
riley: can you share a sample header?
carla: {"X-Client-Version":"v2-2026-03","X-Request-Mode":"stream"}
alex: indexer drops partial fragments without final-marker; routing counts fragments as separate requests. v2 uses chunked partials more.
matt: so console undercounts v2. billing uses routing logs right?
riley: billing uses request-level token accounting, yes. but rollout UI uses console percentages -> rollout risk.
carla: proposal: (1) change console ingestion to emit fragment_count and request_count consistently, (2) add discrepancy metric to rollout dashboard, (3) backfill 30d for reconciliation and notify sales.
alex: can do indexer tag + backfill in 1 PR. estimate 1d dev + 2h smoke + 2h canary. deploy-bot: schedule smoke?
deploy-bot: scheduled indexer/ingest-v2.1-smoke -> canary 02:00 UTC tomorrow. tests: ingest-compat, fragment-replay, console-agg.
matt: add regression alert if fragment_count/request_count > 1.5 after deploy.
carla: will add banner in rollout UI about accounting change. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
